method: Input: research/derived/repairs/lesson_furigana.json `residue` (W21, keyed by lesson+surface), lesson text read from git HEAD. (1) MECHANICAL: a span that is a radical/component character (亻 氵 宀 ...) takes kanjialive `rad_name_ja` for its radical form (supplement/Kangxi/positional-PUA character mapped explicitly); a lone kanji the prose prints as a component of another kanji takes the kanjialive name for the matching position (言 left = ごんべん, 日 left = ひへん, 金 left = かねへん, 食 left = しょくへん, else the standalone radical name). (2) CONTEXT: every other span takes the reading its own lesson fixes: kana printed beside it, a sibling span already carrying the reading, the gloss, the lesson title, the bank kana of the sentence it explains, or (kanji-exame checklists) the reading the lesson's own exercises drill, stem form like the sibling checks. Digits are spelled in kana because READING_OK excludes them. (3) Rows the context cannot settle to ONE reading per (lesson, surface) stay in `undecided` with the reason. Radical names cannot align against the Layer-A kanji registry (the characters are not in it) and 明日/風邪/下手 are 熟字訓 that kanji_align refuses: the apply needs a kanjialive-source and a whole-word allowance for those rows rather than silently skipping them.
